title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - Agreement
description: An agreement represents a contract or arrangement, either written or verbal and sometimes enforceable by law, such as a service level agreement or a customer price agreement. An agreement involves a number of other business entities, such as products, services, and resources and/or their specifications. (TM Forum TMF651 Agreement Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition Agreement; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Agreement:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Agreement'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Agreement/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:Agreement:<tmfId>. Unique identifier for the agreement

href.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Agreement/properties/href'. Unique url identifying the agreement as a resource

agreementType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Agreement/properties/agreementType'. The type of the agreement. For example commercial

Narrative that explains the agreement and details about the it , such as why the agreement is taking place.

initialDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Agreement/properties/initialDate'. Date at which the agreement was initialized

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Agreement/properties/name'. A human-readable name for the agreement

statementOfIntent.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Agreement/properties/statementOfIntent'. An overview and goals of the Agreement

status.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Agreement/properties/status'. The current status of the agreement. Typical values are: in process, approved and rejected

version.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Agreement/properties/version'. A string identifying the version of the agreement

agreementAuthorization.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Agreement/properties/agreementAuthorization'. A business participant that is responsible for approving the agreement.

agreementItem.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Agreement/properties/agreementItem'. A part of the agreement expressed in terms of a product offering and possibly including specific terms and conditions.

agreementPeriod.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Agreement/properties/agreementPeriod'. The time period during which the Agreement is in effect.

agreementSpecification.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Agreement/properties/agreementSpecification'. AgreementSpecification reference. An AgreementSpecification represents a template of an agreement that can be used when establishing partnerships. In TMF this is a AgreementSpecificationRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced AgreementSpecification entity (urn:ngsi-ld:AgreementSpecification:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

associatedAgreement.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF651_AgreementManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF651-Agreement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Agreement/properties/associatedAgreement'. Agreement reference. An agreement represents a contract or arrangement, either written or verbal and sometimes enforceable by law, such as a service level agreement or a customer price agreement. An agreement involves a number of other business entities, such as products, services, and resources and/or their specifications. In TMF this is an array of AgreementRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced Agreement entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Agreement:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.
